bilateral_framework: EU-Indonesia Voluntary Partnership Agreement (VPA) FLEGT Licensing
statutory_mechanism: FLEGT-licensed timber shipments are deemed legally harvested ipso jure without requiring additional risk assessment by EU competent authorities.
historical_outcome: Over 280,000 maritime timber consignments cleared EU ports (Rotterdam, Hamburg, Le Havre) with 0% detention rate and average customs clearance time under 1.5 hours.
replication_blueprint_for_eudr: Pair national electronic SVLK legality licenses with Sentinel-2 post-2020 zero-deforestation polygon verification to achieve automated Green Lane customs release.

bilateral_framework: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO-C) Green Customs Corridor
legal_basis: Union Customs Code (Regulation (EU) 952/2013) Article 38 & EU SWE-C Integration
statutory_mechanism: Operators maintaining automated WORM electronic audit trails and verified plot geolocations receive lowest risk score (Box 44 TARIC code Y128 / Y130 fast-pass).
historical_outcome: Reduced physical inspection frequency from standard 9% down to 0.08%, saving €340 per container in demurrage and port storage fees.
replication_blueprint_for_eudr: Embed SHA-256 pre-validated Due Diligence Statement (DDS) reference code directly into Box 44 of the Single Administrative Document (SAD).

bilateral_framework: Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur (GUCE) Single Window Direct Integration
legal_basis: EUDR Article 19 Competent Authority Electronic Customs Interoperability
statutory_mechanism: Direct API handshake between Le Conseil du Café-Cacao national farm registry and EU TRACES-NT electronic customs clearing hub.
historical_outcome: Automated batch clearance of 45,000 MT cocoa shipments with instantaneous certificate validation upon ocean bill of lading issuance.
replication_blueprint_for_eudr: Standardize smallholder producer IDs using canonical ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 prefixes coupled with WGS84 polygon verification.
